summary: The last day to file: It is the last day to file for {open seat}, and {adviser} says today or never.
realLife: After fighting the Carmel, California, council over a building on his property, he decided to run for mayor hours before the 1986 filing deadline. The incumbent attacked his unlisted phone number, and he won in a landslide.
